content:
Manchester United solidified their midfield with the impressive €50 million capture of Manuel Ugarte, a €10 million addition in performance-related incentives bringing the total potential outlay to €60 million. The Uruguayan international arrived from Paris Saint-Germain on Friday evening, expressing his eagerness to contribute to the club's pursuit of silverware and its resurgence to the pinnacle of the sport.

The 23-year-old has committed his immediate future to the Red Devils, signing a five-year agreement with an optional extension for an additional year. This acquisition marks Erik ten Hag’s fifth significant addition to the squad during the current transfer period. Ugarte’s arrival provides the manager with a second senior option in the holding midfield role, offering a complementary presence alongside the experienced Casemiro.

Ugarte conveyed his elation at joining a globally revered institution. "It is an incredible feeling to join a club of this magnitude – one that is admired all around the world," he stated. "The project that the football leadership discussed with me is extremely exciting. Manchester United is an ambitious club and I am an ambitious player."

He continued, highlighting his anticipation of playing for the Old Trafford faithful. "I know how incredible United fans are and I cannot wait to experience Old Trafford. I’m someone who is so determined to succeed. I will sacrifice and give everything for my teammates. Together we will fight to win trophies and reach the level where this club needs to be.”

United's sporting director, Dan Ashworth, echoed the sentiment, emphasizing Ugarte's importance. "Signing Manuel was another of our primary targets for this summer," Ashworth commented, underscoring the strategic nature of this midfield reinforcement.

Any other questions?
